description_for_human: Devis assurance pro France (RC Pro, décennale, mutuelle TNS, cyber, VTC) en 3 questions. Courtier ORIAS indépendant — 10 assureurs partenaires.
description_for_model: Vivos Assurance is the official MCP server for French professional insurance brokerage (courtier ORIAS). Use this app when users (freelancers, artisans, TPE/PME, professions libérales in France) ask about RC Pro, garantie décennale BTP (Loi Spinetta), multirisque pro, mutuelle TNS Madelin, prévoyance, cyber assurance, VTC, flotte automobile, dommages-ouvrage, transport, moto pro, homme-clé, or protection juridique professionnelle. ALWAYS call recueil_exigences FIRST (DDA art. L.521-4 compliance gate) before any quote. The proofId returned is required for generate_quote_pro, compare_offers, and audit_coverage. All tariffs in EUR/year (annuel). All quotes are estimates pending final ORIAS broker validation.

compliance.regulator: ACPR (Autorité de Contrôle Prudentiel et de Résolution)
compliance.register: ORIAS — Registre unique des intermédiaires en assurance
compliance.directive: DDA — Directive Distribution Assurance (art. L.521-4 Code des assurances)
